description: Manage session diagnostics and maintenance surfaces separate from play-facing session controls. compress summarizes the audit log while compact prunes it irreversibly; verify compares live state with recorded hashes and replay reads the retained log, and both are read-only; visibility_check records its decision in the audit log while visibility_audit reads recent decisions; health, subscribe, and category reassignment do not change Novel content. compact is GM-only. Use when: reporting health, summarizing or compacting the audit log, subscribing, reassigning a category, appending/reading the event log, verifying or replaying state, or scanning a draft for GM-only disclosure. Do NOT use when: recapping play, setting verbosity, or reordering the briefing — use manage_session.

action.description: health, context_report, compress, compact, subscribe, category, event, history, verify, replay, visibility_check, or visibility_audit.

audience.description: Audience badge for a visibility check (visibility_check; default the active badge).

budget_tokens.description: Positive token budget for tier assembly (recap; REQ-592) or for ledger packing (context_report; REQ-610).

category.description: New category label, or null/empty to restore the default (category).

detail.description: discover response detail: summary (default) or schema (live input schemas for the matches; requires query; REQ-609).

gm_notes.description: GM-only free-text notes returned only to the Game Master badge (recap).

max_entries.description: Positive integer; returns a non-mutating summarize prompt over the most recent entries (compress).

ordinals.description: Exact event ordinals to return in order (history; REQ-591).

query.description: Optional search term matched against tool name, description, and title (discover).

session_id.description: Archived session id to include in recap (recap).

sessions.description: Number of recent sessions to retain live; triggers irreversible compaction (compact; default TTRPG_AUDIT_RETENTION_SESSIONS).

supersede.description: Ordinal of an event this observation replaces (event).

through_ordinal.description: Return events up to and including this ordinal (history).

to_event.description: Target event ordinal for replay inspection (replay; default the newest retained entry).

name: manage_diagnostics

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Session Diagnostics
